title: VHL payload in the SMART Health Links payload format
description: Restates SMART Health Links; IHE VHL ITI-YY3, 2:3.YY3.4.1.3 Expected Actions; VerifiableHealthLinkPayload logical model (trust-phw); Stakeholder directive: Verifiable Health Links follow IHE VHL, CBOR map at key 5.

statements.label: VHL payload in the SMART Health Links payload format
statements.requirement: The library SHALL model the VHL payload as the SMART Health Links payload format that IHE VHL reuses: url (required, https), key (required, 43 base64url characters encoding 32 bytes), exp (optional integer, epoch seconds), flag (optional; the letters L and P in alphabetical order), label (optional, at most 80 characters), v (optional integer, default 1) and extension.fhirBaseUrl (optional). Validation SHALL report each violation. The single-file U flag is out of scope and SHALL be reported as unsupported.

sources.quote: Create the VHL payload (using the SHL payload format)
